name: dotsunited/simple-login-for-doccheck
description: WordPress plugin that protects selected pages behind a DocCheck login.

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check all PHP files for syntax errors.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: Check the code against the WordPress Coding Standards.
scripts-descriptions.phpcbf: Fix the coding standard violations that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run the syntax check and the coding standards check.
